dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product shows supplementary content or a secondary task (filters, details of the selected item, a settings pane) in a panel at the end edge: beside the content on a wide screen, where the person works in both, and over it on a compact one, where the panel must be finished or dismissed first.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a side sheet reads: per variant (standard: beside the content; modal: over it) the container color, elevation, the shape of the corners that face the content, and the color of the edge that faces it; its width, paddings and edge width; the scrim; the header's height, gap and end inset, and the close button's Button variant; the headline's style and color; the content color; the dividers above the actions and below a scrolled header; how the actions are arranged, their default Button variant, their gap and padding; and the enter and exit motion.
rules: A standard sheet sits beside the content and is set apart from it by its edge; a modal sheet is raised over the content and set apart by its elevation and the scrim.

The close button is an icon-only Button of the medium size in the variant comp.side-sheet.close-button.variant names (tonal in the default system). The actions are Tanrei Buttons, marked confirming or dismissive; the sheet places them as a full-width Button group and gives a Button without a variant the one comp.side-sheet.actions.variant names (tonal in the default system). It never changes a variant the product set, nor any Button's size or tokens.
A modal sheet offers at least one action; a standard sheet may have none.

Choose another look for every side sheet of a product by re-valuing comp.side-sheet.actions.variant, comp.side-sheet.actions.arrangement and comp.side-sheet.close-button.variant in its layer; set a Button's variant for one action only.
The headline names the sheet; keep it to a few words.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never fork the component.

modal.$description: Tanrei's level1 is only the hairline ring, so a sheet raised over the content rests at level2 (as the modal drawer).

shape.$description: The corners at the sheet's start edge, the edge that faces the content; the corners at its end edge meet the screen's edge and stay square.

width.$description: The sheet's width, not counting the system inset at its end. A modal sheet on a narrow window gives way so that a strip of scrim stays pressable (SSH-7).

padding-inline.$description: From the sheet's start and end edges to the headline, the content and the actions.

padding-block.$description: Above the content when there is no header, and below it when there are no actions.

color.$description: The edge at the sheet's start, facing the content.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A modal sheet is set apart by its elevation and the scrim, not by an edge.

color.$description: The dim over everything behind a modal sheet, alpha included: the modal layer's, unless a system sets the side sheet apart.

blur.$description: How much the scrim behind a modal sheet blurs what lies behind it: the modal layer's (0, none, in the default system).

height.$description: The header row's minimum height; the headline and the close button are centred in it, and it grows with a headline that wraps.

gap.$description: Between the headline and the close button.

padding-inline-end.$description: From the sheet's end edge to the close button: less than the content's inset, so that the close glyph lines up near the text column while its target stays whole.

variant.$description: The Button variant of the close button, an icon-only medium Button (SSH-5). The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values, the core Button variants; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product decides once how its sheets' close control stands out: a tonal button that reads as a control on any content, or a bare glyph that leaves the header to the headline.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A choice of kind; no dial scales it.

color.$description: The foreground the sheet hands to its content, as the platform's inherited color.
The hairline above the actions, drawn while there are actions, and the one below the header, drawn as divider.visibility says (SSH-11, SSH-19).

visibility.$description: When the divider below the header is drawn. always: whenever the header is drawn, at rest as well as while the content is scrolled, as the divider above the actions is. scroll: only while the content is scrolled away from its top (SSH-19). Follows the system's choice; the dividerVisibility prop overrides it. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product rules its side sheet's header off from the content as the edge of a region that stays beside the page, while another shows the line only once the content has scrolled under it; a sheet that stands in the page's layout may be set apart from the dialogs drawn over it.

gap.$description: Between two actions, in a row or stacked. At sys.target.touch minus the lowest Button (small, 32) or more, every action keeps its whole target in a column, as comp.button-group.standard.gap and comp.dialog.actions.gap do.

arrangement.$description: How the actions sit. fill: a full-width Button group, the actions sharing the sheet's inner width equally. start: at their own widths, the row aligned to the start edge. Either stacks into a column when the row does not fit (SSH-11). The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product decides once how the actions at the foot of its side sheets sit: as equal, full-width targets, or as a compact row under the start of the text column that leaves the rest of the width empty.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A choice of kind; no dial scales it.

variant.$description: The Button variant the sheet gives an action whose variant the product did not set (SSH-17). An action whose variant is set keeps it. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values, the core Button variants; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product chooses the emphasis of its side sheets' actions once, for every sheet, rather than on each Button.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A choice of kind; no dial scales it.

padding-block.$description: Above and below the row of actions, between the divider and the sheet's bottom edge.

enter-duration.$description: How long a sheet takes to slide in (and a modal sheet's scrim to fade in), or a standard sheet to open in the layout: the modal layer's, so that every modal surface of a product keeps one tempo.

exit-duration.$description: How long a sheet takes to slide out (and a modal sheet's scrim to fade out), or a standard sheet to close in the layout: the modal layer's, so that every modal surface of a product keeps one tempo.
